windows.title: Weft Studio — Weft zero-copy visual flagship

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws://localhost:* ipc://*

budget.note: Pillar 7 mandate: total distributed bundle < 15 MB, cold start < 200 ms. Budget accounting: Tauri system webview shell (~2.1 MB loader) + Weft Studio webapp payload (< 0.2 MB) + icons/locales (~12.7 MB headroom reserved, unused). The webview runtime itself is provided by the OS (WebView2/WKWebView/WebKitGTK) and is NOT counted in the distributed bundle.
